id.description: Unique identifier for the output parameter.

position.description: Position/order of the parameter in the output list.

paramDescription.description: Human-readable description of what this output parameter represents.

agentToolConfigurationId.description: UUID of the parent tool configuration.

parentId.description: UUID of the parent parameter for nested structures.

paramPath.description: JSON path to this parameter in the output structure.

outputExample.description: Example value demonstrating the expected output format.

dataType.description: Data type of the output parameter.

isArray.description: Whether this parameter returns an array of values.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the parameter was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the parameter was last updated.
